summary: Seek live subagent leases instead of scanning historical claims

replay.detail: No claim replay or current-state projection is added. Existing claim records remain authoritative.

schema.detail: Schema initialization builds claims_subagent_renewed_max_lease_index with subject, subagent ID and numeric lease expiry, then drops the replaced claims_subagent_renewed_index. Existing expiry indexes remain unchanged. Existing stores build the replacement once at startup.

rules.detail: Appearance, maximum renewal expiry, ended-state exclusion and canonical ordering are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No route or response changes. Roster spans gain st.roster.phase.subagent_leases.wall_ms and cpu_ms attributes.

downtime.detail: The first startup after upgrade builds one replacement expression index over renewal history before serving reads. Later startups reuse the index.

manual.detail: No operator migration command or configuration change is required.

recovery.detail: Claim bodies are not changed. A prior binary recreates its original renewal index on startup and can still read the database.
